تستعرضون (form X)
# تَسْتَعْرِضُونَ (tastaʕriḍūna) /tas.taʕ.ri.dˤuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَعْرَضَ (istaʕraḍa)
# تُسْتَعْرَضُونَ (tustaʕraḍūna) /tus.taʕ.ra.dˤuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَعْرَضَ (istaʕraḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
